ranking_rationale: What separated the top from the bottom was whether the trace attached its boundary decision to a quantity it could actually point at: hgf and factor_memory both located a concrete anchor and named the mechanism carrying it into the target quarter, while principle_memory did the same honest job with the weaker number available to it. The bottom three all crossed or straddled a precise threshold on purely directional grounds, and two of them (direct_forecast, structure_memory) reversed their own recorded prediction between the reasoning and forecast blocks, with structure_memory inventing a [-20, 20] interval to justify a 0.7 it had just declared itself unable to support.
shared_evidence_note: Both causes are present but the bank difference dominates: the 16% Q3 2025 figure exists only in E1, so the two E1 traces could anchor on a number straddling the 15.95% threshold and reached 'yes', while the E0 traces saw only headline-level Q3 coverage plus the 12% Q4 2024 print and mostly reached 'no' — yet within E0 the methods still diverged (structured_reasoning said 'yes', principle_memory and case_memory said 'no') from identical material, so reasoning differences matter on top of the bank split.
